input_fields.name: requested_property
input_fields.description: Exactly one property or one fixed measurement record, such as area, normal, or center.

input_fields.name: coordinate_sampling_rule
input_fields.description: Coordinate frame and, for a curved-face normal, the explicit sample point/rule.

result_fields.name: face_measurement
result_fields.description: Requested property value, face identity, coordinate/sampling context, and unit.

procedure: Resolve face_reference and validate the single requested property.
Apply coordinate_sampling_rule; for a curved normal, use one declared sample point rather than a global normal.
Read the property once and return face_measurement plus property_status.
Do not bundle unrelated face properties or modify/select the face.
rejection_rules: Reject an ambiguous face, multiple requested properties, missing curved-face sample, or incompatible frame.
Reject a planar/global normal assumption for a curved face.
Do not infer analytic type from one measured property.
